tweets.body: As AI becomes an active library, we can educate students on 2 tiers: (I) how to ask the right questions and understand the answers, and (II) how to  verify and check AI’s claims. (I) is basic, useful & requires less then the past; (II) requires elite expertise & knowledge.

tweets.body: Congratulations to Netanel Chen on his first published paper as a Ph.D student! Our work studies the effects of airfoil elasticity on quasistatic aerodynamics and divergence, as well as lift, aerodynamic center, and twist angle. Check it out – https://t.co/34kEL8c2V8.
